description: Defines the AppTheme class which provides theme configurations for a Flutter application, including light theme settings with Material 3 support, custom colors, components, and system UI overlays.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate ThemeData for the application, mainly the light theme.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured for light mode with custom settings.

methods.name: _colorScheme
methods.description: Generates and returns a ColorScheme object used in the theme.
